brokers.name: PeopleFinders
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CA data broker registry as 'Peoplefinders, LLC., and its subsidiaries and affiliates' (CA DOJ registration #186872). CCPA deletion/opt-out requests get a 45-day response.
brokers.notes: Part of the PeopleConnect network (per PeopleConnect's own suppression-center brand list). Individual opt-out form requires locating the exact profile URL, then submitting name + email; a verification email confirms suppression. The PeopleConnect centralized suppression center (suppression.peopleconnect.us) also covers this brand and is the preferred single-request path.

brokers.name: Intelius
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CA data broker registry as 'Intelius, LLC' (CA DOJ registration #537529). Consumers can also request removal via phone ((888) 245-1655) or email (support@mailer.intelius.com).
brokers.notes: One of the original PeopleConnect (formerly H.I.G. Capital-backed) brands; also operates ussearch.com/pro.ussearch.com and powers ZabaSearch's backend. Opt-out via the site's own form or the PeopleConnect suppression center suppresses across Intelius, US Search, and ZabaSearch together.

brokers.name: US Search
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Operated by Intelius, LLC, which is CA-registered (CA DOJ registration #537529 covers intelius.com, ussearch.com, and pro.ussearch.com jointly per the registration text).
brokers.notes: Runs on the same backend as Intelius. The brand-specific privacy center form works standalone; the PeopleConnect suppression center (suppression.peopleconnect.us/?brand=USSearch) is the consolidated alternative.

brokers.name: TruthFinder
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CA data broker registry as 'TruthFinder, LLC' (CA DOJ registration #186697).
brokers.notes: Came into the PeopleConnect fold via PubRec LLC's 2020 merger (PubRec also brought Instant Checkmate). Site has its own 'Suppress My Data'/'Do Not Sell' links; support also reachable at help@truthfinder.com or (800) 699-8081. Also honors the PeopleConnect centralized suppression center.

brokers.name: Instant Checkmate
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CA data broker registry as 'Instant Checkmate, LLC' (CA DOJ registration #186698).
brokers.notes: Instant Checkmate LLC was formerly PubRec LLC, which merged into PeopleConnect Holdings, Inc. in 2020 (PeopleConnect is an H.I.G. Capital affiliate). Support also reachable via support@instantcheckmate.com or (800) 222-8985. Sister brand of TruthFinder.

brokers.name: ZabaSearch
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No standalone CA data-broker registration found for ZabaSearch specifically; the brand is powered by Intelius, LLC (CA DOJ registration #537529), which is CA-registered.
brokers.notes: ZabaSearch does not run its own opt-out form; requests are proxied to Intelius, which in turn resolves through the PeopleConnect suppression center. Expect a redirect chain (ZabaSearch -> Intelius -> PeopleConnect) rather than a single-page flow. Listing removal reported to take up to a week.

brokers.name: PeopleLooker
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Covered by the CA data broker registration for 'BeenVerified, LLC, and its subsidiaries and affiliates' (registrant contact privacy@ltvco.com), which explicitly lists PeopleLooker, Ownerly, and NeighborWho alongside BeenVerified.
brokers.notes: UNCERTAINTY: sources are inconsistent on the precise corporate chain — some describe PeopleLooker/Ownerly/NeighborWho as owned by The Lifetime Value Co. (LTVCO), others describe them as part of PeopleConnect alongside BeenVerified. Kept parent_id 'peopleconnect' to match the existing beenverified registry entry (same parent_id, same shared database and shared opt-out form: https://www.beenverified.com/app/optout/search). Confirm current corporate structure before relying on this for legal correspondence.

brokers.name: NeighborWho
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Covered by the CA data broker registration for 'BeenVerified, LLC, and its subsidiaries and affiliates' (registrant contact privacy@ltvco.com), which explicitly lists NeighborWho alongside BeenVerified.
brokers.notes: Same corporate-chain uncertainty as PeopleLooker/Ownerly (LTVCO vs. PeopleConnect attribution varies by source) — see peoplelooker entry notes. Shares BeenVerified's database and opt-out form. Site also has its own 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' footer link that routes to the same form.

brokers.name: Ownerly
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Covered by the CA data broker registration for 'BeenVerified, LLC, and its subsidiaries and affiliates' (registrant contact privacy@ltvco.com), which explicitly lists Ownerly alongside BeenVerified.
brokers.notes: Same corporate-chain uncertainty as PeopleLooker/NeighborWho — see peoplelooker entry notes. Primarily a property/home-value lookup brand but shares the BeenVerified people-search database and opt-out form.

brokers.name: 411.com
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Same jurisdiction posture as Whitepages (honors requests from all US residents; CA residents get CCPA-specific language) since 411.com listings are suppressed through the Whitepages mechanism.
brokers.notes: 411.com is owned/powered by Whitepages Inc. and has no separate opt-out form of its own: find the listing on 411.com, copy its URL, then submit it at the Whitepages suppression-requests page. Unlike Whitepages' base web-form flow, 411.com listings require an additional phone-verification step (an automated robocall reads back a code for the requester to confirm). Kept parent_id null (not grouped under a new owner_group) since the base registry's whitepages entry also has parent_id null; grouping them would require also updating the whitepages entry's parent_id in the same merge pass, which is out of this fragment's scope. Listings can reappear after data refreshes.

brokers.name: Radaris
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No web opt-out form; deletion must be requested by email. Include full name, phone number, and URL of the listing in the email.
brokers.notes: Does not have a self-service opt-out form. Email request is the only path. Use render_email.py to draft the deletion request. Turnaround is typically 7–14 days; follow up if no confirmation within 30. UPDATED from base registry: parent_id changed from null to 'radaris-network' to resolve bidirectional owner_group consistency now that affiliated clone sites (Centeda, Vericora, Pub360, Dataveria, NewEnglandFacts) have registry entries of their own. Also note Radaris has a separate self-service web form at https://radaris.com/control/privacy per current site content, which may supersede the email-only mechanism recorded in the prior entry — worth re-verifying live before relying on this field.

brokers.name: Centeda
brokers.owner: Unclear — WHOIS/registrant-pattern evidence ties it to the Radaris operator
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No CA data broker registration found under the Centeda name.
brokers.notes: Krebs on Security reporting (2024) ties centeda.com's WHOIS registration history to the same registrant fleet as Radaris and other 'clone' people-search sites (virtory.com, clubset.com, newenglandfacts.com, pub360.com, etc.). No stated corporate owner on the site itself. Opt-out requires copying the exact profile-report URL into the control/privacy form, plus a CAPTCHA; if the form errors, contact support by email with full name and listing URL. Removals reported within 3–14 business days but reappearance is common across this network.

brokers.name: Vericora
brokers.owner: Unclear — evidence ties it to the same operator network as Radaris/Centeda
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No CA data broker registration found under the Vericora name.
brokers.notes: Reported by multiple opt-out trackers as part of the same clone-site cluster as Radaris/Centeda/Pub360 (see also the near-identical 'Verecor' variant, verecor.com, which may be a further clone — not independently verified/added here). Opt-out form requires the profile URL, name, email, and a CAPTCHA; confirmation email must be clicked. Fallback email contact: mailus@vericora.com.

brokers.name: Pub360
brokers.owner: Unclear — evidence ties it to the same operator network as Radaris/Centeda
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No CA data broker registration found under the Pub360 name.
brokers.notes: Named directly in Krebs on Security's Radaris WHOIS-registrant-fleet reporting. Opt-out requires locating the profile via the site's People Information Deep Search, copying the profile URL into the control/privacy form along with name and email, and passing a CAPTCHA; confirm via emailed link.

brokers.name: Dataveria
brokers.owner: Unclear — evidence ties it to the same operator network as Radaris/Centeda
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No CA data broker registration found under the Dataveria name.
brokers.notes: Commonly listed alongside Centeda/Vericora/Pub360 as part of the same clone-site cluster (opt-out trackers describe near-identical form flow and identical underlying data). Requires profile URL, name, email, and CAPTCHA; confirmation link sent by email. Fallback contact: customer@dataveria.com. Removal reported within 7–14 business days.

brokers.name: NewEnglandFacts
brokers.owner: Unclear — named directly in Krebs on Security's Radaris WHOIS-registrant-fleet reporting
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No CA data broker registration found under the NewEnglandFacts name.
brokers.notes: UNCERTAINTY: available sources describe the opt-out flow (search profile from homepage, click 'Control this Profile', submit name + email, confirm via emailed link; fallback csr@newenglandfacts.com) but do not explicitly confirm a CAPTCHA step the way they do for Centeda/Vericora/Pub360/Dataveria — marked captcha_required true here on the assumption it matches its sibling sites in the same operator network, but this specific field should be re-verified live rather than trusted from secondary sources. No dedicated opt-out sub-path was confirmed beyond the homepage search flow, so opt_out_url points at the homepage.

peopleconnect.notes: A single opt-out at the PeopleConnect centralized suppression center (suppression.peopleconnect.us, login-gated, requires email verification + DOB match) suppresses listings across all member brands. File once, not once per brand. UPDATED from the base registry: the old centralized_opt_out_url (https://www.peopleconnect.us/do-not-sell) now 404s and has been replaced with the current suppression-center URL; the members list has been expanded from the original 5 (beenverified, peoplefinders, intelius, ussearch, truthfinder) to include instantcheckmate, zabasearch, peoplelooker, neighborwho, and ownerly, which research for this batch confirmed are part of the same PeopleConnect/BeenVerified network. CAVEAT: PeopleConnect is reported to operate close to 20 total sites (others cited in passing include Classmates, Addresses.com, PeopleLookup, DateCheck, PublicRecords.com) — those were NOT researched or added as broker entries in this batch and remain undocumented in the registry.

radaris-network.notes: These sites are not documented as a formal corporate family the way PeopleConnect is. The grouping is based on Krebs on Security's 2024 investigative reporting, which found the same WHOIS registrant email addresses (tied to Gary Norden) across Radaris and a fleet of clone people-search sites including centeda.com, virtory.com, clubset.com, kworld.com, newenglandfacts.com, and pub360.com, plus secondary reporting linking vericora.com and dataveria.com to the same cluster (along with backgroundcheck.run, councilon.com, inforver.com, ofsearch.com, persontrust.com, verecor.com, veriforia.com, and others not added here). Each site requires a SEPARATE opt-out submission — there is no shared centralized suppression portal like PeopleConnect's. Treat 'owner' fields of the non-Radaris members as unverified; no entity has been confirmed by corporate registration to control this network.
